content: Padael Mala Yalol Deus Le Ye Budoh Mo Irel Mala Lol
Muswe ngo ye cholop igegal ngo ye cholop yad yael Deus hapatpat ngalir profeta kowe ngo ir resa hadayu ngalir chapdoh kowe yach.

Iwe ngo yela ralleka, ngo molwe Lol mele yesa hadayu ngalgich mekla yalol. Deus ye tapeli mala Lol bo yebe hasub laeng mo talop. Iwe ngo yesa duwley mala Lol le bela wol mirilloh, ngo iy mele yebe lamli pangal formel.

Iy Jesus ye kawraloh termal falmay la yael Deus. Ngo iy ila ye hafedeg ngal chog Deus, ngo ye kekamale pangal formel irel kkamelal mala yalol. La wol miril yal hachuya fael yar molfid re talop, ngo ye sala marodiy mo woal laeng rela gilemra irel Deus, le ye hartael tagiyet.
Mala Lol Deus Le Ye Tagiyet
Deus ye hatagita mala Lol mo imor angelus, le ye wochog mala idal le ye fang ngali le ye hatagita mo imol mekla ider.

Bo tor fael sew le Deus ye kangalu semal angelus kowe lol bo, “Gel layi, igla mele iy sa mel bo Tamom.” Ngo tor fael sew le Deus ye sor irel semal angelus bo, “Iy bele mel bo Temal, ngo iy yesa mel bo layi.”
Ngo yodwe Deus ye bele fangdiy molwe mol Lol woal talop le ngo yesa sor bo,

content.text: “Panger angelus ka yusuwel Deus ngo rebe hasrowu mele Lol.”

content: Iwe ngo irel kofer angelus ka, Deus ye sor bo,

content.text: “Deus ye forur angelus bo rebe mel
bo yaeng mo bbulul yaef.”

content: Iwe ngo la irel kofael molwe Lol ngo Deus ye sor bo:

content.text: “Mala Lamliyem ho Deus ila yebe mel le towe yor siyal!
Ho lamlir meka lom le ye fel.
Ho hachangi mekla ye momay ngo ho hafobidiri meka ye tayikof.
Ila fal le Deus le yam Deus yesa duwleh
ngo ye fang ngalug rraeyel ssor la ye tagiyet
mo imol ila ye fang ngalir mekla wocchilam.”

content: Ngo iy ye wol sor bo,

content.text: “Chapdageldah chog ngo gel ho Samol
mele ho foru talop mo laeng le foriyel lal pom.
Pangal meka ngo be moaloh ngo gel yebe tabtobloh chog yam mel.
Ngo rebe towas le be wochog mengag kowe yesa bes.
Hobe limir le be wochog sew coat,
ngo ir rebe liwel le rebe wochog mengag ka yesa bes.
Iwe ngo gel ila pangal yad ngo be sangsengam chog,
ngo yam molow ila tor siyal.”

content: Tor fael sew le Deus ye kangalur angelus kowe lol bo:

content.text: “Ha maro rela gilemra irey yee,
la hola yodla ibe yitilir rechoka re hattohar ngalugmi fael
mekla pechemi bo rebe mel bo liliyel pechemi.”

content: Iwe meda mele angelus? Ir ngoel le re foforu mekla yalol Deus, ngo Deus yema hagloyur bo rebe tipingir rechoka be yoh le rebe daor.
